# Hosted performance evidence — 2026-09-19

Report: [performance audit](../../../performance-audit-2026-09-19.md).

- [Public route samples](public.json): nine successful cold-context loads; visible-input/overview/first-result endpoints; resources, long tasks, document navigation and paint entries.
- [Authenticated navigation](navigation.json): three repetitions of campaign/table/reference transitions, sanitized WebSocket function names and result byte counts, request timing metadata, no payloads or credentials.
- [Search and direct table loads](search-and-table.json): one fresh and two cached authenticated direct table loads; search lifecycle, article read, warm Foes return, response headers and query delivery times. Phase labels persist until the next measured action, so setup navigation between actions can also appear under the previous label. Restrict timestamped frame analysis to each record's start/elapsed interval.
- [Bundle inventory](bundle-analysis.json): final emitted file sizes and gzip sizes; static imports; up to 20 largest pre-minification rendered-module estimates per chunk. Module estimates are diagnostic attribution, not additive post-minification transfer sizes. Initial static closure: baseline 1,827,886 raw / 458,779 gzip; experiment 488,524 raw / 160,726 gzip.
- [Public harness](public-harness.cjs.txt), [navigation harness](navigation-harness.cjs.txt), [search/table harness](search-and-table-harness.cjs.txt), and [build-only experiment](bundle-experiment.mjs.txt): exact analysis scripts, retained as text. These are audit tooling, not integrated application tests or deployable app changes.

All browser/build work ran through `presidium-dev run browser|build` on CT114 main. Browsers targeted `https://salient-dev.rdxx.workers.dev`, not the private development frontend. Baseline source: `6ddb3cb47e77` locally, equivalent app implementation `62ca7b964c70` in the remote source snapshot. The remote source was not replaced. Builds used Vite API output directories under `/artifacts/performance-audit/`; no publish/deploy command was run and `/app/dist` was not replaced.

For reproduction, provision one disposable hosted account through the normal sign-up UI and a campaign named `Performance audit 2026-09-19`. Save browser storage state to a protected **remote-only** `auth-state.json` and a nonsecret `fixture.json` containing its campaign URL in `/artifacts/performance-audit/`. The navigation harness starts its session and adds six foes; use a fresh fixture for a rerun. Run the search/table harness afterward. Do not reuse another user's campaign or commit browser storage state. The original audit storage state is removed during cleanup.

The public harness needs no fixture. Copy its text to a remote `.cjs` file and run it in the existing CT114 browser service. Dependencies are resolved from `/app/package.json`. The build experiment changes router imports only through an in-memory Vite transform, writes two separate artifact builds, and does not edit source. Its initial `generateBundle` size observations precede Vite's final preload injection; the saved JSON inventory was corrected by reading the emitted files and recomputing `Buffer.length` and `gzipSync` afterward. Any repeat should do that same final-file calculation and traverse all static imports, not compare only entry filenames.

Timing limitations: no artificial throttling; 2 CPU / 2 GiB browser container; one cloud/network vantage; three samples are not percentile estimates. Playwright wall timings include action, page load, readiness polling, and rendering. Cross-origin auth resource sizes are zero in Resource Timing because those responses do not expose timing sizes, not because they transfer no bytes. Search-worker fetches appear in response capture but not the main document's Resource Timing list. A 304/300-byte resource still incurs network revalidation. No real-user campaign payloads, authentication tokens, passwords, or cookies are saved here.

Early selector failures (pre-session table link, wrong log text) are excluded from the successful datasets. No application error is inferred from those harness mistakes. Live existing-campaign access was separately checked with the disposable account and refused normally. No Convex cloud administrative telemetry was available through the configured local MCP.

Cleanup passed: the disposable campaign session was closed through the app, the audit account was signed out, and its remote browser authentication-state file was removed. The test account/campaign remain as clearly labeled test data. Report-relative file links, evidence JSON parsing, credential-pattern checks, and whitespace checks passed. No application test-suite run or deployed optimization is claimed.
